label: Wittgenstein in the 1938 lectures on religious belief: religious beliefs are not hypotheses or…
paraphrase: Wittgenstein in the 1938 lectures on religious belief (student notes, as reported): religious beliefs are not hypotheses or opinions; the evidence and historical events cited for them are not reasons in the way evidence supports a hypothesis, and historical facts introduced in their support are not treated as historical, empirical propositions. A reading of student notes, not of a text Wittgenstein wrote.
